preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**5 and 1 <= Y <= 10**5 and 1 <= Z <= 10**5 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, X, Y, and Z are between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= 10**3 and 1 <= B <= 10**3 and 1 <= C <= 10**3 for X, Y, Z, A, B, C in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, A, B, and C are between 1 and 1,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(energy_loss, int) and energy_loss >= 0 for energy_loss in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is a non-negative integer representing the minimum energy loss.

postconditions.expression: all(energy_loss == min_energy_loss(X, Y, Z, A, B, C) for (X, Y, Z, A, B, C), energy_loss in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output value is the minimum energy loss calculated for the corresponding test case.
